summary: Implemented the window title feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes a single (SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title) tuple. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: pytest and mypy were not run, so the test results and mypy compatibility of the widened union are unconfirmed.
